description.value:
You belong to a lineage that grants you supernatural qualities. If your lineage gives you an ability that calls for a saving throw, its DC equals 8 plus your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom modifier (chosen when you select the lineage) and your Proficiency Bonus. Choose one of the following options:

Mulgore Tauren. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a magically empowered stomp, unless you have the Prone condition or are flying, climbing, or swimming. Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failure, it has the Stunned condition until the end of your current turn.

Highmountain Tauren. As an action, you can move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and through the spaces of other creatures. Each Medium or smaller creature whose space you enter makes a Strength saving throw; on a failure, it takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Strength modifier and has the Prone condition. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Taunka. Your shaggy hide gives you a +1 bonus to Armor Class and Resistance to Cold damage.

Foundry Note

The save DC of the lineage activities uses Constitution: set it to Strength or Wisdom in the activity if you chose that ability.
